item.title: Cool untranslatable foreign words
item.description: hygge - weirdly pronounced Danish word that seems to mean cosiness and can be applied to almost anything apparently. There’s a pretty good explanation on visitdenmark.com (visitdenmark.com/danish-meaning-hygge, no longer online) and I’ve also found a list of 9 ways to get more hygge 🙂
